s: This article explores managing dynamic multi-item input within a single UI card, contrasting the complexity of custom 'add row' patterns with the simplicity of a `<textarea>`, all while leveraging HTMX for client-side DOM manipulation and server interaction.
sub: HTMX for dynamic form interactions and DOM updates
Managing unbounded lists of data within a single UI component
Trade-offs between custom UI patterns ('add row') and simple inputs ('textarea')
Library integration challenges (FastHTML vs. dominate) and avoiding rabbit holes
Leveraging client-side DOM persistence for single-page application workflows
